room.style: [gentle female fairy-tale princess voice, warm and friendly, light melodic tone, clear British English, unhurried storytelling, speaking not singing]
room.text: Welcome, designer! Tap the rug to walk. Choose a studio to explore. Solve a maths question to earn play money for your styles.

wardrobe.style: [gentle female fairy-tale princess voice, warm and friendly, light melodic tone, clear British English, unhurried storytelling, speaking not singing]
wardrobe.text: Choose a gown you love. Solve maths questions to earn play money. Styles you buy are yours to wear again.

hair.style: [gentle female fairy-tale princess voice, warm and friendly, light melodic tone, clear British English, unhurried storytelling, speaking not singing]
hair.text: Choose a hairstyle and a colour you like. You can wear styles you already own for free.

makeup.style: [gentle female fairy-tale princess voice, warm and friendly, light melodic tone, clear British English, unhurried storytelling, speaking not singing]
makeup.text: Choose your favourite makeup. Keep practising maths to unlock more styles.

show.style: [gentle female fairy-tale princess voice, warm and friendly, light melodic tone, clear British English, unhurried storytelling, speaking not singing]
show.text: Choose an outfit that matches the show theme. Solve a fresh maths question, then take the stage!

party.style: [gentle female fairy-tale princess voice, warm and friendly, light melodic tone, clear British English, unhurried storytelling, speaking not singing]
party.text: Win three fashion shows in a row to earn a party invitation. Then celebrate with a little dance!

maths.style: [gentle female fairy-tale princess voice, warm and friendly, light melodic tone, clear British English, unhurried storytelling, speaking not singing]
maths.text: Read the question and choose your answer. Take your time. If you need help, tap the little hint. You can always try again.

help.style: [gentle female fairy-tale princess voice, warm and friendly, light melodic tone, clear British English, unhurried storytelling, speaking not singing]
help.text: Welcome to Makeover Maths! Solve questions to earn play money. Use it to open studios and choose your look. Enter fashion shows, earn party invitations, and enjoy your adventure!
